source_evidence: Alternative mutual funds may have higher expenses than their traditional mutual fund peers.
question: Misconception: Alternative mutual funds always have lower expenses than traditional mutual funds because they generally charge lower fees than hedge funds. What is the correction?
answer: Lower fees than hedge funds do not necessarily mean lower expenses than traditional mutual funds. Alternative mutual funds may have higher expenses than traditional mutual fund peers because their complex strategies can require significant expertise and active management, and may generate additional expenses.
